title: Story premise ENT086: The Progress Bar Painter
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: One hundred percent of what? Takeaway/theme: Measure the work you mean to complete.
description: A painter wants a progress meter for a mural, but keeps painting the meter itself until the bar reaches 100 percent beside an empty wall. They relabel it METER COMPLETE, laugh, and replace it with small checkboxes for actual mural sections, finishing one visible section before the cut.
